rootLifecycleScripts.build: npm run compile && npm run bundle && npm run copy-assets

approvedDependencies.name: esbuild
approvedDependencies.reason: Required to link and validate esbuild's lockfile-pinned platform binary. The reviewed installer contains npm and HTTPS fallback downloads plus child-process execution, but the rebuild wrapper first requires the matching @esbuild platform package and binary, removes credential-bearing environment variables, forces npm offline, and rebuilds only this exact package. With that preflight satisfied, the normal path only links the local binary and executes it with --version.
